name: transfer_to_agent
description: Transfer the caller to a human agent queue in Avaya Infinity. Use this when the customer requests a human agent, or when the issue cannot be resolved by the virtual agent.

queue_id.description: The Infinity queue ID to transfer the caller to. Must be a valid queue ID configured in the Infinity Workflow Designer.

reason.description: Brief reason for the transfer. This is passed as context to the receiving agent.

tags.description: Optional tags to attach to the interaction for routing or reporting purposes.
